via.name: Kaipo River
via.quote: follow the true right of the Kaipo River

evidence: This track leaves from the car park 5 km along Clements Mill Road.

It climbs to a clearing where the Te Iringa Hut used to be (1-2 hours), then skirts around Mt Te Iringa (1241 m), before dropping down to the Tikitiki Stream/Kaipo River junction where the track forks at a swingbridge.
Take the main track straight ahead and follow the true right of the Kaipo River down to Oamaru Hut, situated near the confluence of the Kaipo and Oamaru rivers.

From near the Mohaka River a new track links from the end of the poled route to Oamaru Hut via a crossing of the Kaipō River.

evidence: From Oamaru Hut the track follows the true left bank of the Oamaru River before crossing the headwaters and following the Waitawhero Stream up to a saddle.
Across the valley the Boyd airstrip can be seen. Boyd Hut is obscured by beech forest behind the airstrip.

ways.label: Boyd Hut to Cascade Hut via Maungaorangi

start.name: Boyd Hut
start.quote: This strenuous track from Boyd Hut

via.name: confluence of the Waitawhero and Oamaru streams
via.quote: Near the confluence of the Waitawhero and Oamaru streams

via.name: Maungaorangi
via.quote: a long, steep ridge up Maungaorangi

evidence: This strenuous track from Boyd Hut follows the track over Waitawhero Saddle towards Oamaru Hut.
Near the confluence of the Waitawhero and Oamaru streams the route turns left onto a long, steep ridge up Maungaorangi.
It then descends to Te Waiotupuritia Saddle and on down to Cascade Hut.

evidence: A marked route runs from the swingbridge on the Te Iringa/Oamaru Track to Cascade Hut.
The track then climbs to a ridge just south of Kaipo Saddle. Descend off the ridge to Cascade Stream and the track junction.
The right-hand track heads downstream for another 30 minutes to Cascade Hut.

evidence: The track follows the open river flats of the Tauranga-Taupo River downstream before climbing away from the river up a prominent beech-covered ridge.
The track drops down to the Clements Mill roadend following the Hinemaiaia Stream and its tributaries.

doubts: This page covers several tracks of a hut network, so it is recorded as a network with each described track as its own way; W1 is marked main only because it comes first. No road-end feature exists for Clements Mill Road, so the Clements Mill starts/ends have no ref. F1 is the only road end on Taharua Road and was taken as the Taharua roadend car park, but the text gives no detail to confirm it. The saddle in W3 is taken to be Waitawhero Saddle (T15) because W4 says the Boyd Hut track goes 'over Waitawhero Saddle towards Oamaru Hut'. The text does not say whether trips are one way or return; ways are A-to-B track sections.
